The main takeaway from our work is that
the data on coherent φ production are well explained by the conventional mechanism of φ photoproduction off nucleons, whereas the data on incoherent φ production are not.

the data on the γd → φnp reaction at low energy and momentum transfer are consistent with the hypothesis that the φ meson is not produced by an exotic baryonic resonance, but rather by the conventional N∗(1535) and Δ∗(1620) resonances.
